style: Icon-first accent animation, NOT text-heavy. 3 clean line-art button icons (phone / quote-document / chat) are the hero visual, arranged in a horizontal row on rounded-rect 'button chassis' cards. Each pops in staggered left-to-right with a glow-pulse 'activation' moment as it lands, like a button being pressed live. A short punchy label appears beneath after all three have landed, then a clean freeze-hold. Purple/black brand system, matches shared-lead-problem and demand-reputation-flywheel sibling pieces.

customize.note: No exact catalog block for a staggered icon-button light-up row + landing glow was found (searched 'icon button row reveal pop in staggered' and 'icon light up glow pulse activate button' — closest hits were icon-swap, icon-morph-beat, badge-pop, beat-pulse-background, none matching the 3-up staggered activation sequence). Hand-authored per builder-contract.md, following the box-shadow yoyo glow-pulse pattern from demand-reputation-flywheel (#ring-glow-pulse) and the inline-SVG symbol + badge pattern from shared-lead-problem (#icon-phone / .lead-icon-badge).

scenes.motion: bg-fill fades in once (0.1-0.4s), persists for the whole piece — never fades out

3 button-chassis icons pop in left-to-right staggered ~0.55s apart (scale_punch, back.out ease): phone at 1.0s, quote/document at 1.55s, chat bubble at 2.1s. Each landing triggers a glow-pulse box-shadow burst (yoyo, repeat 1) on the chassis, like the button being activated/pressed.
label fades up beneath the icon row (fade_in + slight y rise), no overlap with icons, plain legible hold
freeze-hold — no new tweens scheduled, last state persists for a clean cut

icons.label: QUOTE
icons.glyph: document with lines / quote sheet line-art
